summary: Mark Darling of Eaton, sole occupant of a Cessna 172F (N8368U) on a personal flight from Baggs, Wyoming, to Loveland, crashed just after 11 a.m. in the Routt National Forest about 6 miles south-southwest of Rabbit Ears Pass (top of Green Creek between the Sarvis Creek and Harrison Creek drainages, ~10,000 ft); he got himself out of the wreckage, called 911, and started a fire to stay warm; ~20+ SAR personnel on 18 snowmobiles reached him ~3:20 p.m. and extracted him by snowmobile-drawn sled ~8 miles to the Muddy Pass Trailhead staging area, from which a Classic Air Medical helicopter flew him to Denver Health Center in fair condition with serious injuries (NTSB CEN15LA122).
location: Routt National Forest, ~6 mi SSW of Rabbit Ears Pass (Green Creek, between Sarvis Creek and Harrison Creek drainages)
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue (Routt County-led operation; Grand County SAR mutual aid, Grand County EMS, Classic Air Medical helicopter)
notes: Sunday 2015-01-25 weekday-verified; crash site in Routt County near the sinuous Routt/Grand county line; page cites the Steamboat Pilot as the original news source; surfaced via the Steamboat Pilot rotation search-index crawl.
